news.titleEn: ECB Holds Rates as Lagarde Exit Compounds Alarm Over Oil, France
news.conclusionEn: The ECB kept its deposit rate at 2.5% on Oct. 29, hours after President Christine Lagarde announced she will step down on Feb. 7, 2027, about nine months before her term ends.
news.conclusionZh: 欧洲央行利率按兵不动在2.5%，拉加德宣布明年2月提前卸任
news.whyEn: Euro-zone borrowers and the euro face a leadership change at the ECB while energy-driven inflation and French debt stress are already high, and a December hike is still on the table.
news.whyZh: 通胀高企、法债承压之际央行换帅，12月仍可能加息，影响欧元与欧债
news.detailEn: The decision followed two rate hikes earlier this year, and Lagarde said the Governing Council debated whether another hike was appropriate before deciding against it. Policymakers flagged upside inflation risks from oil prices tied to the Iran war and the Strait of Hormuz disruption. Lagarde said she wants freedom to speak on issues beyond monetary policy, and earlier reports linked the timing to France's 2027 presidential election. The race to succeed her, with names such as Klaas Knot and Pablo Hernandez de Cos mentioned, will now be watched closely by bond markets.
news.detailZh: 这次决定前，欧洲央行今年已加息两次。拉加德表示管委会讨论过是否再加息，最终决定暂不行动。决策者提示，伊朗战争和霍尔木兹海峡受阻推高油价，通胀仍有上行风险。拉加德称希望在货币政策之外的议题上自由发声，此前有报道认为时间安排与2027年法国大选有关。接班人选（如克诺特、埃尔南德斯·德科斯）将成为债市关注焦点。

news.titleEn: Alphabet tanks nearly 13% for worst day ever, losing $500 billion in value
news.conclusionEn: Alphabet shares fell about 13% on Thursday, their worst day since Google's 2004 IPO, wiping out roughly $500 billion in market value and dragging the Nasdaq down 1.4%.
news.conclusionZh: 谷歌母公司股价单日暴跌约13%创纪录，市值蒸发约5000亿美元
news.whyEn: It shows investors are now punishing AI spending that has no clear payback, which hits index funds and the wider tech sector hard because Alphabet is one of the largest stocks.
news.whyZh: 市场开始惩罚回报不明的AI投入，巨头大跌直接拖累指数和科技板块
news.detailEn: Alphabet reported negative free cash flow of about $9 billion for the quarter, far worse than analysts expected, as AI capital spending outran cash generation. Search advertising grew 12% to $63.35 billion but missed estimates, which analysts read as a first sign that AI tools may be eating into search. The drop beat the previous record one-day fall of 11.6% in March 2020. Several analysts downgraded the stock, and investors will now look harder at every big tech company's AI spending plans.
news.detailZh: 由于AI资本开支超过经营现金流入，Alphabet本季自由现金流约为负90亿美元，远差于预期。搜索广告收入增长12%至633.5亿美元，但低于预期，分析师认为这是AI开始蚕食搜索业务的初步迹象。此次跌幅超过2020年3月11.6%的单日最大跌幅纪录。多家机构下调评级，投资者将更严格审视各大科技公司的AI支出计划。

news.titleEn: Third-quarter U.S. GDP increases a better-than-expected 3.4% as September inflation accelerates
news.conclusionEn: The U.S. economy grew at a 3.4% annualized pace in the third quarter, beating the 3.1% estimate, while September PCE inflation picked up and stayed well above the Fed's 2% target.
news.conclusionZh: 美国三季度GDP年化增长3.4%超预期，但9月通胀再度加快
news.whyEn: Strong growth plus sticky inflation keeps the door open for another Fed rate hike this year, which matters for mortgage rates, the dollar and stock valuations.
news.whyZh: 经济强劲叠加通胀顽固，美联储年内再加息的可能性仍在，影响利率和股市
news.detailEn: Consumer spending rose 3.8% in the quarter, matching the previous pace, and business investment was robust. For the quarter as a whole, headline PCE prices rose 2.1% and core 2.5%, down from 5% and 3.3% in the second quarter. But the monthly September reading showed prices speeding up again, partly because of high energy costs. Treasury yields eased slightly on the day, helping small-cap stocks, but the Fed's next move remains uncertain.
news.detailZh: 三季度消费支出增长3.8%，与上季持平，企业投资也很强劲。整个季度看，PCE物价整体上涨2.1%、核心上涨2.5%，低于二季度的5%和3.3%。但9月单月数据显示物价再度加速，部分源于能源成本高企。当天美债收益率小幅回落，提振了小盘股，但美联储下一步动向仍不明朗。

news.conclusionEn: Amazon's third-quarter revenue of $201.9 billion and EPS of $1.89 slightly missed estimates, and shares fell more than 6% after hours despite AWS growth accelerating to 39%.
news.conclusionZh: 亚马逊三季度营收和利润略低于预期，盘后股价跌超6%
news.whyEn: Even a 39% cloud growth rate could not offset worries about negative free cash flow from AI spending, deepening the big-tech selloff.
news.whyZh: 云业务增速39%也抵不过AI烧钱导致的负现金流担忧，科技股抛压加剧
news.detailEn: AWS revenue reached $45.98 billion, above the $45.29 billion consensus, with operating income up 55%. Advertising revenue of $19.64 billion fell short of the $20.82 billion analysts expected. Amazon posted negative free cash flow for a second straight quarter, with a trailing 12-month outflow of $42.4 billion, and kept its 2026 capex forecast at $220 billion. The company's operating margin of 13.9% was its highest ever, but investors focused on spending.
news.detailZh: AWS营收459.8亿美元，高于452.9亿美元的预期，经营利润增长55%。广告收入196.4亿美元，低于分析师预期的208.2亿美元。亚马逊连续第二个季度自由现金流为负，过去12个月净流出424亿美元，并维持2026年2200亿美元的资本开支预期。13.9%的经营利润率创历史新高，但投资者更关注支出。

news.titleEn: Iran war live: IRGC says four tankers struck mines in Strait of Hormuz
news.conclusionEn: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said four tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines while using "unauthorised" Hormuz routes, while U.S. Central Command said the main shipping lanes had been cleared of mines.
news.conclusionZh: 伊朗革命卫队称4艘油轮在霍尔木兹触雷起火，美军否认航道有雷
news.whyEn: The strait carried about a fifth of world energy supply before the war, so every new attack keeps Brent crude above $100 and feeds global inflation.
news.whyZh: 海峡战前承载约五分之一全球能源，新袭击让油价维持在百元以上
news.detailEn: The IRGC says ships must seek Iran's permission to cross, and it has repeatedly claimed mine strikes this month on vessels it says used illegal routes. U.S. officials dispute the mine claims, and maritime security officials have said there is no evidence of mines in the strait. Brent has traded around $113 to $117 a barrel this month, roughly 60% above pre-war levels. Shipping costs from the Gulf to Asia have soared, and peace talks remain the main factor that could bring prices down.
news.detailZh: 伊朗革命卫队要求过往船只须获其批准，本月多次声称有船只因走「非法航线」触雷。美方对触雷说法提出质疑，海事安全官员也表示没有海峡布雷的证据。本月布伦特油价在每桶113至117美元左右，比战前高约六成。海湾至亚洲的运费大涨，和谈进展仍是油价能否回落的关键。

news.conclusionEn: Intel shares plunged more than 20% after hours as a weak fourth-quarter forecast, blamed on soft PC demand, overshadowed a third quarter that beat its own guidance.
news.conclusionZh: 英特尔四季度指引疲弱，盘后股价暴跌超20%
news.whyEn: It signals a slump in the PC market and adds to pressure on chip stocks just as investors are already selling big tech.
news.whyZh: 反映PC市场走弱，在科技股抛售潮中进一步打压芯片板块
news.detailEn: Third-quarter revenue rose 21% to $16.5 billion, with the strongest data center growth in 15 years. But Intel guided fourth-quarter revenue to $15 billion to $16 billion and non-GAAP EPS of just $0.25. The company pointed to continued weakness in the global PC market, one of its core businesses. The drop, together with Amazon's slide, pushed Nasdaq-100 futures lower.
news.detailZh: 三季度营收增长21%至165亿美元，数据中心业务增速为15年来最高。但英特尔预计四季度营收仅150亿至160亿美元，非GAAP每股收益仅0.25美元。公司称全球PC市场持续疲软，而PC是其核心业务之一。英特尔与亚马逊双双下跌，拖累纳斯达克100期货走低。

news.titleEn: DoorDash's $17 Billion Instacart Deal Aimed at Walmart, Amazon
news.conclusionEn: DoorDash agreed to buy Instacart for $65 a share, or about $17 billion, mostly in cash, to build a bigger grocery and local-delivery rival to Walmart and Amazon.
news.conclusionZh: DoorDash以约170亿美元收购Instacart，联手对抗沃尔玛和亚马逊
news.whyEn: It is the biggest consolidation yet in U.S. delivery and will reshape fees and choices for consumers, grocers and gig workers, subject to antitrust review.
news.whyZh: 美国即时配送行业最大整合，将影响消费者、商超和骑手，须过反垄断审查
news.detailEn: The price is a 26% premium to Instacart's close on Oct. 22, before media reports of a deal. At least 75% of the consideration will be cash, with the rest in DoorDash stock. DashPass and Instacart+ members will eventually pay one membership fee instead of two. The deal is expected to close in late 2027 or the first half of 2028, and both apps will run separately until then.
news.detailZh: 收购价较10月22日（交易传闻曝光前）Instacart收盘价溢价26%。对价中至少75%为现金，其余为DoorDash股票。未来DashPass和Instacart+会员只需付一份会员费。交易预计在2027年底或2028年上半年完成，在此之前两个App将独立运营。

news.conclusionEn: Eli Lilly's third-quarter revenue jumped 39% to $24.4 billion on Zepbound and Mounjaro, beating estimates and prompting a raised full-year outlook; shares rose about 7%.
news.conclusionZh: 礼来三季度营收大增39%并上调全年指引，股价涨约7%
news.whyEn: Weight-loss drugs remain one of the strongest growth stories in markets, offering a rare bright spot outside AI tech as big tech sold off.
news.whyZh: 减肥药仍是最强增长赛道之一，在科技股下跌时成为市场亮点
news.detailEn: Adjusted EPS came in at $7.48, well above the $6.26 consensus. Demand for the GLP-1 drugs Zepbound and Mounjaro continued to surge. CEO David Ricks said the quarter beat the company's own expectations, allowing it to raise its full-year guidance. The results strengthen Lilly's lead in the obesity-drug market as competitors race to launch rival products.
news.detailZh: 调整后每股收益7.48美元，远高于6.26美元的市场预期。GLP-1类药物Zepbound和Mounjaro需求继续猛增。CEO戴维·里克斯表示本季表现超出公司自身预期，因此上调全年指引。在竞争对手加速推出同类产品之际，这份财报巩固了礼来在减肥药市场的领先地位。

businessTips.explanationEn: Succession planning means preparing in advance who will take over key roles when a leader leaves, retires or is suddenly unavailable. It covers identifying candidates, developing them, and setting a clear handover timeline. Good planning reduces uncertainty for staff, customers and investors. Poor planning can turn a single departure into a crisis.
businessTips.explanationZh: 继任规划是指提前安排关键岗位的接班人，以应对领导者离职、退休或突然缺位。它包括识别候选人、培养他们，以及设定清晰的交接时间表。做得好能减少员工、客户和投资者的不确定感；做不好，一个人的离开就可能演变成危机。
businessTips.exampleEn: Lagarde announced her exit date more than three months ahead, giving EU leaders time to pick a successor before France's 2027 election. A small business owner can do the same by documenting key processes and training a deputy before taking a long break.
businessTips.exampleZh: 拉加德提前三个多月宣布卸任日期，让欧盟领导人能在2027年法国大选前选出接班人。小企业主也可以照做：在长假前把关键流程写成文档，并培养一位副手。

businessTips.explanationEn: Bundling means selling several products or services together for one price that is lower than buying them separately. It raises the average order value and makes customers less likely to leave, because cancelling means losing several benefits at once. It works best when the items are complementary and the customer already wants at least one of them. The risk is giving away too much margin.
businessTips.explanationZh: 捆绑销售是把多个产品或服务打包成一个价格，比单买更便宜。它能提高客单价，也让客户更难流失，因为取消就会同时失去好几项权益。最适合搭配互补、且客户本来就想要其中至少一项的产品。风险在于让利过多、压缩利润。
businessTips.exampleEn: After its Instacart deal, DoorDash plans one fee covering both DashPass and Instacart+. A side-hustle example: a photographer could bundle a photoshoot, edited images and a printed album at a package price instead of charging for each separately.
businessTips.exampleZh: DoorDash收购Instacart后，计划让DashPass和Instacart+合并为一份会员费。副业例子：摄影师可以把拍摄、修图和实体相册打包成套餐价，而不是分别收费。

businessTips.explanationEn: Index concentration risk arises when a handful of very large companies make up a big share of a market-cap-weighted index. A sharp fall in one or two of them can drag the whole index down, even if most other stocks are fine. Many investors who think they are diversified through an index fund are actually heavily exposed to a few tech giants. Checking an index's top 10 holdings shows how concentrated it is.
businessTips.explanationZh: 指数集中度风险是指少数超大公司在按市值加权的指数中占比过高。只要其中一两家大跌，即使大多数股票表现正常，整个指数也会被拖累。很多人以为买指数基金就分散了风险，其实高度押注了几家科技巨头。查看指数前十大持仓就能判断集中程度。
businessTips.exampleEn: On Oct. 29, Alphabet's 13% drop helped pull the Nasdaq down 1.4%, while the small-cap Russell 2000 actually rose about 1%. An investor holding only a Nasdaq-100 fund could balance this by adding an equal-weight or small-cap fund.
businessTips.exampleZh: 10月29日，Alphabet大跌13%拖累纳指下跌1.4%，而小盘股罗素2000指数反而上涨约1%。只持有纳斯达克100基金的投资者，可以搭配等权重或小盘股基金来平衡。
